exam: 106年公務人員高等考試一級暨二級考試
subject: 英文

essays.text:
英譯中：
① U.N. Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs chief Stephen O’Brienwarned that more than 20 million people face starvation in Yemen, Somalia, SouthSudan, and Nigeria, in what he says is the largest humanitarian crisis since 1945. Theconcurrent famines have a common, disturbing theme: they are man-made, precipitatedby conflict and perpetuated by political jockeying.（15 分）
② Generation Z is the demographic cohort after the Millennials. A significant feature ofthis generation is the widespread usage of the Internet from a young age; the Gen Z-ersare typically thought of as being comfortable with technology, and interacting on socialwebsites for a significant portion of their socializing. They also have a more DIYattitude about job skills, thanks to their love of YouTube how-tos.（15 分）

中譯英：
①民眾坐在公共運輸工具的博愛座是否應該讓座？因為當某人看起來沒事，並不表示他真的沒事。不過，如果你沒病痛，就應該讓座給身障者、懷孕者或年長者，這是合乎道德且可接受的選擇。（15 分）
②陰謀論者常被認為是誇大其辭，但根據多項民意調查和估計，有半數美國公民認為政府隱瞞有關 911 事件的事實，將近四成民眾相信氣候變遷可能不是真的，甚至三分之一的人認為政府隱藏外星生物的證據。（15 分）

英文作文：（40 分）A new law has gone into effect in Taiwan banning the euthanasia of stray animals. Thatmakes Taiwan the second country in Asia to implement a zero culling policy, followingIndia. Write an English essay of 2 paragraphs: one explains the policy and the other givesyour opinion of it with concrete examples.（請接背面）
